title: SlicingRules
description: Stage 3 Slicing Rules Definition. Governs the 6 Static Universal Architectural Dimensions, canonical strategies, and verification media.

1_slicing_topology.name: Slicing Topology
1_slicing_topology.purpose: Forces single tracer-bullet anchor selection; rejects parallel/horizontal layer creation until Slice 1 is verified. Reads bootstrap_floor and DAG-derived substrate set.

2_execution_semantics.name: Execution Semantics
2_execution_semantics.purpose: Resolves Sync vs Async vs Polling/Batch vs Event-driven execution constraints. Enforces drain-and-cancel barriers before failovers.

3_state_and_lifecycle.name: State & Lifecycle
3_state_and_lifecycle.purpose: Enforces explicit handling for entity deletion, mergers, cascade cleanups, and state transitions including ephemeral persistence and temporal egress.

4_idempotency_and_ordering.name: Idempotency & Sequence Ordering
4_idempotency_and_ordering.purpose: Specifies duplicate detection strategy, token keys, monotonic clocks, and retry behavior. Forbidden to be marked NOT_APPLICABLE on actor-repeatable triggers.

5_external_boundaries.name: External Boundaries & Resource Lifecycle
5_external_boundaries.purpose: Maps required Boundary Class fixtures, environment isolation, signal/teardown handlers, and concurrency budgets against Stage 1 probed capacity.

6_observation_and_actor_modality.name: Observation & Actor Modality
6_observation_and_actor_modality.purpose: Defines per-state observers, verification media, discriminators, input modalities, environment floors, and headless fallback policies.
